goal: Reproduce the reported bug, minimise it to the smallest failing case, then fix it without breaking anything else
rules: First produce a reliable reproduction and record the exact steps or failing test in the log
Minimise before fixing: strip the reproduction to the smallest input that still fails
The fix must make the reproduction pass and the full test suite stay green
State the root cause in one sentence in the log, not just the symptom
No speculative fixes: every change must trace to the reproduced cause
